description: Submit a bulk email verification job (1 verify credit per email). Provide "emails" (array) or "path" (CSV; the email column is detected from common headers like "Email Address"). Duplicates are removed before submitting. Set "output" to wait and save every result to a local CSV in one call.

email_column.description: email column name, if it is not detected

max_credits.description: refuse to submit if the job could cost more than this

output.description: wait, then write all results to this local CSV path

path.description: Path to a CSV file with an email column

wait.description: wait for the job to finish (default false)

name: kanta_verify_bulk
